description: The keyword any is allowed in a type constraint with defaults
notes: The README allows any in function TypeConstraint only, and TypeConstraintWithDefaults is a different function, but its documentation says it parses a type constraint, which TypeConstraint's documentation says additionally allows the keyword any. hashicorp/hcl reads both with getType (ext/typeexpr/get_type.go), which allows any whenever it reads a type constraint, with or without defaults.
